# Danial Panah

> Senior AI / Machine Learning Engineer. 10+ years in software and backend engineering, the last year and a half on production AI systems: LLM applications, agentic and tool-calling systems, RAG, fine-tuning and MLOps. Based in Bulgaria, open to remote roles and contract work.

## What he does

- Builds LLM applications and agentic, tool-calling systems that run in production, with evals, guardrails and cost controls (Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP).
- Designs RAG pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), hybrid search, reranking, semantic caching.
- Fine-tunes open-weight models with PyTorch and Hugging Face (LoRA/QLoRA) and evaluates them.
- Ships and operates models with MLOps on AWS and Azure: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLflow, monitoring for latency, cost and error rate.
- Backend foundation: Go, Python, TypeScript; event-driven microservices, real-time and WebSocket systems, NATS JetStream, Redis, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, multi-tenant SaaS.

## Selected work

- CryHub (2026): LLM-driven anomaly and pattern detection pipeline on real-time crypto market data, built on the Anthropic Claude API; replaced manual review. 4-service event-driven platform, 8-stream NATS JetStream topology, Redis, TimescaleDB, WebSockets.
- AI Job-Application Co-Pilot (2026): self-built platform that drafts tailored resumes and screening answers from a structured profile, with human review on every submission. OpenRouter routing across three model tiers with budget caps, a 3-layer cache (exact match, pgvector embeddings, provider prompt cache), Chrome extension for capture and form pre-fill.
- Subke GmbH (2023-2026): multi-tenant enterprise CRM and logistics platform, 30+ domain service classes, database-driven RBAC, real-time messaging hub, JTL ERP integration.
